eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Eleven
subtitle: Lesson 96 · Database Design Fundamentals

caption: Every DepartmentID here must already exist as a primary key in Department.

code:
ALTER TABLE dbo.Employee
ADD CONSTRAINT FK_Employee_Department
FOREIGN KEY (DepartmentID)
REFERENCES dbo.Department (DepartmentID);
caption: Real example: Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID references ProductSubcategory.
The constraint physically prevents orphaned data — no application code required.

code:
ALTER TABLE dbo.Employee
ADD CONSTRAINT FK_Employee_Department
FOREIGN KEY (DepartmentID)
REFERENCES dbo.Department (DepartmentID)
ON DELETE CASCADE;
caption: Now deleting a Department automatically deletes every Employee in it — use with care.

subtitle: Uniqueness without making something the primary key.
